headline: GTA 6 countdown: 4 days to go
title: GTA 6 Countdown 4 Days Left | Map reportedly 3x RDR2 | Vice City Is Back
video_script: Only 4 days until GTA 6. Its map is reported to be three times larger than the playable area of Red Dead Redemption 2. Grand Theft Auto 6 comes out on 19 November 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. Are you playing it on day one? Comment below!
joke: Your fast travel finger is already warming up.
description: GTA 6 countdown - 4 days to go. Its map is reported to be three times larger than the playable area of Red Dead Redemption 2. Grand Theft Auto VI launches on 19 November 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Facts from Rockstar's announcements as summarised on Wikipedia.
